readme.name: README_2016_2018.pdf
readme.review_method: Text extraction and actual visual inspection of both pages, rendered at 612 by 792 pixels with PyMuPDF on one CPU.
readme.reported_collection_period: August 2016-August 2018; exact instrument timestamps not yet inspected
readme.reported_format: NetCDF, one processed file per deployed instrument
readme.processing_scope: Calibration, clock-drift correction, interpolation to even time grids and manual edits are described. File attributes contain units, accuracies and processing notes; these have not been inspected. Detiding must not be assumed from this README.

coverage_limit: The README lists eight LS moorings. Pacini et al. (2020), section 2a, uses ten including DSOW3 and DSOW4. Do not assume this archive alone reproduces the full paper array.
next_gate: After the active cloud delivery finishes, acquire selected originals in a bounded cloud stage, verify archive custody/member inventory and instrument metadata, then freeze a prospective width extraction method before any measurement.
